skill.name: Flash Frost
skill.description: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.

skill.name: Frostbite
skill.description: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing damage. If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.

skill.name: Tactical Sweep
skill.description: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.

skill.name: Warrior Trickster
skill.description: Wukong becomes <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font> and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

skill.name: Crushing Blow
skill.description: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

skill.name: Nimbus Strike
skill.description: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

skill.name: Arise!
skill.description: Azir summons a Sand Soldier to attack nearby targets for him, replacing his basic attack against targets within the soldier's range. Their attacks deal magic damage to enemies in a line.

skill.name: Shifting Sands
skill.description: Azir shields himself briefly and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, damaging enemies. If he hits an enemy champion, he instantly readies a new Sand Soldier for deployment and halts his dash.

passive.name: Crimson Curse
passive.description: Briar's attacks and abilities apply a stacking bleed that heals her for a portion of the damage it deals. Perpetually hungry, she gains increased healing based on her missing Health, but lacks innate Health Regeneration.

skill.name: Seastone Trident
skill.description: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.

skill.name: Chum the Waters
skill.description: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

skill.name: End of the Line
skill.description: Graves fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain.

skill.name: Ground Slam
skill.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

skill.name: Command: Dissonance
skill.description: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.

skill.name: Comet Spear
skill.description: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.

skill.name: Shield Vault
skill.description: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

skill.name: Dark Matter
skill.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

passive.name: The Relentless Storm
passive.description: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

rankValues.label: Attack speed per stack per 100 AP

skill.name: Sky Splitter
skill.description: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.
